propositions: Implement a two-phase lexer that locks protected blocks (fences, HTML comments, indented code) before applying classification rules to prevent pandoc from escaping code, deleting markers, or corrupting delimiters

Classify and render units by type: locked/safe blocks pass exact, inline-Jira markers (unambiguous vs ambiguous) are scanned before pandoc to avoid re-rendering cycles, ASCII tables wrap once in {noformat}, HTML tags pass exact, regex-dangerous prose passes exact, and remaining prose converts via pypandoc commonmark→jira

Substitute arrows (→, ←, ↔, ⇒) in one regex pass ordered to protect HTML comment delimiters (<!--, -->), code fragments, and regex metacharacters, then enforce post-render code-preservation: every source code span must appear verbatim in output or fall back

Commit a deterministic 178-body scrubbed corpus (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) from scripts/build_dc_wiki_corpus.py with per-stratum pinned cardinality and require body ratio ≥0.90 and character ratio ≥0.95 with non-vacuous dispatched-and-changed validation

Add pypandoc-binary==1.15 (bundling pandoc 3.6.1) as a wiki optional extra with hard-pinned versions, real binary gate on Linux/macOS, and fallback identity when absent; return content-free wiki_render_fallback events with reason=pandoc_absent/conversion_failure/preservation_failure only

Strip content-free {anchor:} after headings, pass pre-existing {color:name} and {{monospace}} exactly (pandoc never emits color), handle five-pass idempotency via unambiguous/ambiguous Jira classifier split to eliminate 2-cycle instability, and leave WikiTextCodec and all live sends unchanged
